scenarios.name: sr_identity_duplicates_and_conflict
prove: SR identity is exactly eight digits; invalid rows create no SR
equivalent duplicates collapse logically with warning; conflicting variants block only that SR
approximate evidence never adopts identity

one conflict-free canonical SR absent from LLD-03 emits one medium-risk observed-row sr_create_or_adopt with target_internal_id=null, target_business_id=canonical SR, and exactly one ordinal-0 official_sr_no create identity change with after_text=canonical SR and source_observation_field_id=null
its base token is exact LLD-03 SR_SOURCE_IDENTITY_BASE_V1 with target=null; appearance of that official SR before acceptance changes the token and stales before receipt
acceptance revalidates same-run immutable canonical identity evidence and exact create-change shape; malformed change, cross-run evidence, nonnull target_internal_id or non-medium risk fails closed
successful acceptance creates only the official SR identity and accepts no other workbook field

scenarios.name: source_timezone_and_timestamp_grammar
prove: filename chronology uses Asia/Shanghai; operational cells use ADVANCED_SEARCH_SR_V1 instant grammar

text timestamps require ASCII YYYY-MM-DD plus T/space plus HH:MM:SS, optional 1..6 fractional digits and optional uppercase Z or +/-HH:MM; locale/slash dates, lowercase z, abbreviations, missing seconds and malformed offsets fail
offsetless operational timestamps use America/Guayaquil; explicit Z/numeric offset wins
resolve instant first, then discard fractional remainder without rounding/carry to UTC whole seconds
Excel 1900/1904 temporal cells are accepted only when openpyxl resolves date/datetime; bare numeric temporal cells or formula cached values are malformed
pre-1970 resolved instants are malformed, never negative Unix seconds
Objective timezone never enters source interpretation

a disjoint ordinary sibling remains independently reviewable in either acceptance order
accepted Status drift changes the Status field-set token and stales the reversal

scenarios.name: population_disappearance_preserves_history
prove: compare only against prior accepted Advanced Search population
omission yields high-risk population_absence review bound to complete run, prior observation and exact LLD-03 SOMA_SR_SOURCE_PRESENCE_BASE_V1
fabricate no current observation; an open reviewed warning suppresses duplicate disappearance proposals
acceptance revalidates presence token plus SrSourcePresenceEvidenceProvider and appends one LLD-03 disappearance_reviewed event only; no delete/archive/finalize/purge/source-field/reference mutation
GetServiceRequest warning derives from LLD-03 event-chain head, never pending/rejected/deferred proposal
successful later advanced_search_sr publication enqueue_or_coalesces one run-keyed ticket_import.sr_reappearance_reconcile job; failed publication enqueues none
worker scans immutable valid canonical SR observations in keyset pages <=500 and opens one replay-safe owner command per active warning
provider requires exact published run/observation/canonical SR; malformed, ambiguous, wrong-SR/source or indeterminate evidence cannot resolve warning
field warnings/unusable nonidentity fields do not block valid canonical identity reappearance
reappearance_confirmed references the exact open event for the same service_request_id, clears only disappearance warning, accepts no field and never recreates identity
later disappearance may open a new immutable cycle; prior cycles remain queryable

sr_customer_reconciliation has one customer_org_id identity change from current/null to exact reviewed LLD-02 customer_org_id
fingerprint binds all Customer matcher inputs/evidence; source_observation_field_id points to strongest field, preferring usable Account Code over Org label

accepted Customer history uses origin_kind=advanced_search_review and preserves reconciliation_proposal_id

Current Handler text stays source-owned; current_handler_reference resolves only exact current accepted source observation
accepted SR source-field observation stores exact LLD-04 source_observation_field_id validated by SrSourceEvidenceProvider
ambiguous Customer/Contact stays unresolved and never blocks independent valid source facts
sr_contact_reconciliation has one contact_id change from current customer_contact/null to exact reviewed contact, bound to exact usable customer_contact_label evidence

current-run Handler observation/hash remains fingerprint-bound and its usable label must equal the accepted supporting Handler field

ReconciliationProposalEvidenceProvider binds customer_contact only to sr_contact_reconciliation and current_handler_reference only to sr_current_handler_reconciliation, with exact contact_id change and outer command/proposal binding
Contact acceptance reruns LLD-02 matching plus LLD-03 reference/source freshness; lifecycle, affiliation, matcher scope, evidence or handler-pointer drift stales before mutation
